findings.observation: Current CMake has no explicit isolated audit/capture targets. Core CI builds only its previous 14 targets and runs 12 named CTests. New C++ sources trigger core CI but are not compiled by its target selection.
findings.recommendation: Add the two isolated audit/capture targets linked PRIVATE nano_core, build both in daily CI, select the new self-test CTest explicitly with reviewed timeout and tooling label. No actual DB/network fixture capture should become an automatic CI test.

findings.observation: Daily core checks only selected name set. DISABLED, SKIP_RETURN_CODE or SKIP_REGULAR_EXPRESSION could retain a registration yet let CTest return zero; generated JUnit is not audited there. Full-run already has strict result and inventory guards.
findings.recommendation: Reject duplicate names and skip properties, require reviewed labels/timeouts and exact selected test count, then audit JUnit against selection. Preserve counts for subset separately from full registry.

findings.observation: The operations glob includes isolated observer/domain/planner tests, but omitting one file would silently remove it from the glob. The observer has 23 static top-level tests, not an independently executed result in this review.
findings.recommendation: Retain explicit required test paths and a scoped terminal result inventory/count with fail, skipped, cancelled and todo all zero. Keep Node tests in operations unless a clearly enabled CMake option includes Node prerequisites.

findings.observation: Transition-test binaries link nano-test-sync-fault with a build-directory RPATH. Inherited standalone helper link templates also include it. Executable-only full manifests do not bind these runtime shared libraries; replacement can change test behavior without altering executable hash.
findings.recommendation: Link new RO helpers to nano_core only. For fault tests retain existing qualified linkage but pin the resolved shared-library path/hash and loader environment before/after. Docker ARM/AMD historical audit parent inventories already included the .so, so this is not withdrawal of those scoped proofs.

findings.observation: Runner currently requires an empty CMake diff against core85, correctly failing closed. A reviewed append-only test-target suffix will be rejected even if production sources and compiled binaries are identical.
findings.recommendation: Keep strict core source paths and pinned immutable binaries. Admit only exact externally approved CMake bytes and suffix, with a baseline-prefix equality check and production graph/flags proof. Never blanket-remove CMake from the source guard.

nonFindings: RocksDB headers are already SYSTEM PUBLIC usage requirements of nano_core, line30; no current missing include defect. If a helper-specific explicit include is added, make it PRIVATE without changing production target requirements.
prepare_review proposed two PRIVATE nano_core-only helper targets and stopped-capture self-test (timeout15, tooling label), which does not itself alter production compiler/link settings.
Source src/include/cmake/third_party/CMakeLists current diff against core85 was empty at observation; current isolated controller modifications are tests-only.
CI core Ubuntu image does not install Node. A new unconditional find_program(node REQUIRED) would break current core configure; operations is already pinned Node25.9.0.

acceptance: Read baseline from exact core revision and compare its SHA to literal external pin
Require current CMake equals baseline or starts with baseline bytes exactly
If suffix exists, require whole+suffix literal external reviewed hashes; no self-approved checkout value
Reviewed suffix may only configure new helper targets/tests with PRIVATE usage requirements; no global flags, production target mutation or extra include/function affecting nano/nano_core
Require unchanged src/include/cmake/third_party paths against core85 and unchanged relay sources against relay revision
Verify nano+nano-p2p and used core archive hashes from trusted architecture assets before runtime
Configure baseline/current graph with same compiler/environment in separate owned outputs, never qualified-parent directories; normalize only source/build-root prefixes
Compare nano_core/nano source lists, compile definitions/options/includes/language/compiler/link fragments/dependency closure; retain flags.make/link.txt or file-api codemodel SHA independently
Reject LD_PRELOAD/DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES/LD_LIBRARY_PATH or altered loader overrides not reviewed; resolve/hash test libraries when reused
Retain old production-source revision and new test-only repository revision separately; no qualification promotion of uncompiled source revision
